summary.text: Allissa Impink is the Democratic candidate for Indiana State Senate District 46 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She served on the Indianapolis Public Schools board, District 4, from 2025 to 2026.

paragraphs.text: Allissa Impink won election to the Indianapolis Public Schools board in District 4 in the November 5, 2024 general election and held the seat from 2025 to 2026.
In the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for Senate District 46 she defeated Clif Marsiglio and Sam Glynn.
